capabilities: Embed pasted or dropped images as Base64 data URIs directly inside .canvas files
Flip, grayscale, recolor, resize, and adjust opacity of canvas image nodes
Filter and cross-highlight canvas nodes by tags, dominant colors, and labels
Play, scrub, and extract frames from animated GIFs on the canvas
Render high-density boards with adaptive image LOD proxies and IndexedDB caching
extras: README carries a warning that the plugin is possibly unmaintained and the author's focus has moved to Canvast; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: An image toolkit and enhanced visual workspace for Obsidian Canvas.
motivation: The author wanted Canvas to work as a self-contained, portable reference environment for designers, researchers, and visual creators without vault clutter or broken links.
problem: Obsidian Canvas stores pasted images as separate vault attachments with fragile relative links, and offers no in-canvas image adjustment tools for reference and mood boards.

relations.evidence: Canvas image Level of Detail (LOD) functionality is inspired by and based on the Canvas Image LOD plugin.
Keyboard panning functionality is inspired by and based on the Canvas Keyboard Pan plugin.

summary: Canvas extension that embeds images as Base64 data URIs inside .canvas files and adds image manipulation, filtering, GIF controls, and LOD rendering.
